text:
Situation: Potassium acetate 3.93 g/20 mL has been on FDA's shortage list since 2019-06-10 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 88 months. Current inventory across three sites ranges from 12.7 to 22.8 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the product label for NDC 00409818301 names Hospira, Inc. as labeler with two registered plants: Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343, USA) and Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085, India). FDA inspection 1006274 at the Pfizer India plant ended 2017-03-17 classified VAI, 815 days before the shortage posting. Inspection 1039547 ended 2018-02-02 classified VAI, 493 days before posting. Inspection 1066469 ended 2018-09-21 classified VAI, 262 days before posting. Inspection 1106244 ended 2019-09-06 classified OAI, with classification letter dated 2020-05-25, 88 days after posting. A Warning Letter was issued to Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited on 2020-03-25, 289 days after posting. The Hospira plant has a history of OAI classifications in 2010 and 2011, with its most recent inspection classified NAI on 2025-02-07.

Our position: Supply is critically low. The rule-based best option is to buy from Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily and report changes to P&T committee chair; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further market analysis given current days-on-hand.
